## 1. Milestone scope and why EF/schema is deferred

The repo has **no EF/SQL infrastructure today**. M-03-1.1's schema/persistence work item
(WI-03-1.1.2 — `GovernanceDbContext`, `governance` schema, unique index on `(TenantId, Slug)`,
initial EF migration) is gated on **M-01-2.1** (real tenancy — `TenantId` "enforced by M-01-2.1" per the
milestone acceptance) and **M-02-1.4** (the DATA-layer EF Core schema discipline / migration
baseline), neither of which is built. So the EF/schema acceptance criteria of M-03-1.1 are
**recorded as follow-on work, not implemented here**.

What this lane **does** realise, and verifies by build + test:

- **M-03-1.1 WI-03-1.1.1** — `Product` aggregate: `ProductId` typed identity, `ProductSlug`
  (format + per-tenant uniqueness invariant surface), `ProductClassification`, `ProductLifecycleState`.
- **M-03-1.1 WI-03-1.1.3** — product read/write contract `IProductRegistry` and a tested
  `ProductRegistryService` over an in-memory store with duplicate-slug and cross-tenant semantics.
- **M-03-1.2** — delete the misplaced seed `IProductRegistry.cs` from `Nexus.Platform.Contracts` and
  stand up the real L03 GOVERNANCE leaf assembly set.

The EF/`governance` schema follow-on is exactly WI-03-1.1.2 (and the first two M-03-1.1 acceptance
criteria). It is intentionally not scaffolded now: no database project, no `Nexus.Governance.Infrastructure`.

## 3. Type map

### `Nexus.Governance.Contracts` (file-scoped `namespace Nexus.Governance.Contracts`)
References nothing.

| Type | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ProductClassification` | enum | `Internal, Consumer, Business` |
| `ProductLifecycleState` | enum | `Proposed, Active, Sunsetting, Retired` |
| `ProductId` | sealed record | wraps `Value`; rejects null/whitespace; equality by `Value`; friendly `ToString()` |
| `ProductSlug` | sealed record | wraps `Value`; ctor enforces `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`, max 64, throws `ArgumentException` |
| `Product` | sealed record | `(ProductId Id, string TenantId, string Name, ProductSlug Slug, ProductClassification Classification, ProductLifecycleState LifecycleState)` |
| `RegisterProductResult` | sealed record | `(bool Succeeded, Product? Product, string? FailureCode)` + `const DuplicateSlug = "DUPLICATE_SLUG"`, `const InvalidName = "INVALID_NAME"` |
| `GetProductResult` | sealed record | `(bool Found, Product? Product)` |
| `IProductRegistry` | interface | `RegisterProductAsync(tenantId, name, slug, classification, ct)` / `GetProductAsync(tenantId, productId, ct)` / `ListProductsAsync(tenantId, ct)` |

The `IProductRegistry` shape is the M-03-1.1 command/query contract and replaces the old seed's
`IsProductRegisteredAsync` / string-returning `ListProductsAsync` (M-03-1.2 subtask
S-03-1.2.1.1.2 satisfied by deletion + new interface).

### `Nexus.Governance.Core` (`namespace Nexus.Governance.Core`)
References only `Nexus.Governance.Contracts`.

| Type | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `IProductStore` | **internal** interface | `TryAddAsync` (add-if-slug-free) / `GetByIdAsync` (tenant-scoped) / `ListByTenantAsync`. Documented as the seam an EF-backed Infrastructure store must implement later (WI-03-1.1.2). |
| `InMemoryProductStore` | internal sealed | thread-safe (lock around writes and reads), list-backed |
| `ProductRegistryService` | public sealed | implements `IProductRegistry`; name-blank → `INVALID_NAME`; duplicate slug same tenant → `DUPLICATE_SLUG` + no row; same slug different tenant → success; reads tenant-scoped; lifecycle default `Proposed` |
| `GovernanceServiceCollectionExtensions` | public static | `AddGovernance(this IServiceCollection)` registers `IProductRegistry` singleton over the in-memory store |

**Seam note for WI-03-1.1.2 (follow-on):** `IProductStore` is deliberately `internal` today
(per locked design). When `Nexus.Governance.Infrastructure` is built it must be promoted to public or
exposed via `InternalsVisibleTo`; the interface XML documents the EF mapping targets
(unique `(TenantId, Slug)` index; tenant-filtered reads) so the future EF store implements the SAME
abstraction. `ProductRegistryService`'s constructor is `internal` (avoids CS0051 against the internal
store); composition goes through `AddGovernance`.

## 6. DI note

- **`Nexus.Platform.Core.PlatformServiceCollectionExtensions.AddNexusGovernance` stays an empty
  no-op.** CORE may not reference GOVERNANCE (`DEPENDENCY_RULES.md` matrix row 01 has no ● for column
  03). Its XML doc was rewritten to point at the real registration
  (`Nexus.Governance.Core.GovernanceServiceCollectionExtensions.AddGovernance`) and to instruct hosts
  to compose both at the composition root.
- **`Nexus.Governance.Core.AddGovernance` is the real registration** — registers
  `IProductRegistry → ProductRegistryService` (in-memory store) as a singleton.
- **Not wired into any host.** `AddNexusPlatform` still calls the no-op `AddNexusGovernance`;
  behaviour is unchanged. `samples/Nexus.Platform.SmokeHost` is outside the slnx and was **not**
  touched (it composes via `AddNexusPlatform`, which still works). Nothing at runtime resolves
  `IProductRegistry` yet — that wiring is a later composition-root concern once a real host exists.

only `Nexus.Governance.Contracts` among `Nexus.*` assemblies (encoding decisions 2/3/4 in CI).

## 9. Risks / follow-ons (honest)

1. **`IProductStore` is `internal`.** An EF-backed store in a future `Nexus.Governance.Infrastructure`
   cannot implement it without promoting it to public or adding `InternalsVisibleTo`. This is
   intentional for today's seed and is the documented seam; it must be resolved by WI-03-1.1.2.
2. **TenantId is a plain string.** Cross-tenant behaviour is implemented and tested on string
   equality, but real tenancy enforcement (who may register/read which tenant) is M-01-2.1.
3. **`ProductRegistryService` constructor is `internal`.** Composition is via `AddGovernance` DI only;
   there is no public `new` path. Consumers that want the service directly must go through DI.
4. **No host wires `AddGovernance` yet.** Nothing at runtime resolves `IProductRegistry`; the first
   real consumer (Nexus Forge / a host composition root) will call `AddGovernance`. SmokeHost is
   untouched and its behaviour is unchanged.
5. **Slug validation uses a whitelist regex.** Any future slug-format change must update
   `ProductSlug` and its tests together.
6. **EF/schema M-03-1.1 criteria 1 (and full criterion 4) remain open** as recorded follow-on work
   gated on M-01-2.1 / M-02-1.4; they were not implementable in this repo today.

---

## 10. Human decisions

- The locked architecture decisions were followed exactly; none were overridden.
- **Registration mechanism:** because `IProductStore` must stay `internal`, `AddGovernance` registers
  `IProductRegistry` via a factory lambda (`_ => new ProductRegistryService(new InMemoryProductStore())`)
  rather than `AddSingleton<IProductRegistry, ProductRegistryService>()` (the latter would require DI to
  match a public constructor whose parameter is an internal type — impossible without CS0051).
- **Architecture test re-pointing** (see §8) keeps the CORE↔GOVERNANCE boundary assertion meaningful
  after the namespace relocation rather than deleting or weakening it.
- **New dependency-boundary tests** were added inside `Nexus.Governance.Tests` (not the architecture
  project) so the locked Governance-only-references-Contracts decision is CI-checked without growing
  the architecture test project's reference set.
